subject: Pegasus11b elevated 5xx/timeouts — stability check-in and action plan
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@stormwave.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Increased 5xx/timeout on Pegasus11b - urgent

Hi Hannah,

We started seeing a surge of 5xx and timeouts from calls routed to Pegasus11b around 13:40 PDT. End-users report failed character-level parsing in our ingestion pipeline; retrying doesn't always help. Attached are a few example request IDs and a short set of logs.

Can you confirm whether this is a known issue or if we should open a support escalation? Our window is tight — this impacts batch exports and a scheduled demo tomorrow.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior SRE, Stormwave Analytics

Attachment: pegasus11b-error-samples.txt (3KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@stormwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased 5xx/timeout on Pegasus11b - urgent

Hi Laura — thanks for the heads-up and for sending samples. We're seeing a correlated spike in 5xx/errors for Pegasus11b starting ~13:35 PDT; our ops dashboard shows error rate up from ~0.3% to 6.8% for that model.

Immediate steps:
- We've opened an internal incident and are triaging.
- We're enabling a short-term routing policy to prefer Pegasus11b-compat (a slightly slower variant) for new traffic to reduce customer impact.
- Karthik and Ben are looking at recent runtime/kernel changes that landed overnight.

I'll keep you posted with ETA for mitigation (< 2 hours target) and will share a follow-up with cause and long-term fix once triage completes.

Apologies for the disruption — we know the export demo is sensitive.

Hannah
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Pegasus11b 5xx - preliminary triage notes

TL;DR: Root cause appears to be a regression in the allocator layer in commit r5.2.1 that changed buffer lifetime semantics for long-sequence KV caches. Under our new packing heuristics, some long-context requests hit stale KV state and trigger backend stalls that surface as 502/503 from the front-end gateway.

Observations:
- Error spike aligns with a kernel/allocator rollout to a subset of serving nodes at 13:30 PDT.
- Affected requests are predominantly long-context (>8k tokens) streaming calls and batched reranking jobs.
- Enabling the compatibility routing to Pegasus11b-compat reduces error rate to ~0.5% but increases median p95 latency by ~120ms.

Mitigations applied:
1) Rollback allocator change on the impacted pool (rolling, started 15:55 PDT).
2) Hotfix to reject pathological packing in the scheduler (deployed 16:05 PDT).
3) Temporary routing policy (Pegasus11b -> Pegasus11b-compat) for Stormwave and any high-priority routes.

Next steps:
- Confirm rollback completes and observe 1 hour of stable metrics.
- Postmortem write-up (owner: Karthik) and regression test to prevent recurrence with long-context workloads.
- Communicate closure and recommended policy changes to customers.

Attachments: svc_metrics_20260802.png (screenshot of error-rate / p95 on relevant pools)

-ben
Ben Carter
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@stormwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, CloudOps <ops@stormwave.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Pegasus11b incident update — rollback complete and monitoring

Hi Laura / Stormwave team,

Follow-up from the incident on Aug 2 — summary and next steps.

What happened: Pegasus11b started returning elevated 5xx/timeouts for long-context calls after a recent allocator change rolled to a subset of serving nodes. The change altered buffer lifetime handling for large KV caches; under certain packing conditions this led to backend stalls surfaced as 502/503 at the gateway.

What we did:
- Rolled back the allocator change on impacted nodes (completed 16:40 PDT, Aug 2).
- Deployed a scheduler hardening to avoid pathological packing that can exercise the bug.
- Temporarily routed your traffic to Pegasus11b-compat while rollback progressed; routing removed after we validated stability.

Current state (as of 09:00 PDT Aug 4):
- Error rate for Pegasus11b in your tenant has returned to baseline (~0.4%).
- We've observed stable metrics across the last 36 hours with no recurrence.
- We're running an extended verification suite against long-context workloads for 72 hours.

Action items for us:
- Postmortem with timeline, RCA, and regression tests (owner: Karthik Iyer) — due Aug 7 EOD.
- A recommended model-routing policy to prefer the compatibility variant during rolling kernel/allocator upgrades — we'll propose a default policy by Aug 9.
- We will share sanitized logs and a short packer test harness if you'd like to run internal verification.

If you want a separate call to walk through the timeline or get telemetry data, we're available this afternoon. Again, apologies for the disruption — we'll follow up with the formal postmortem.

Sincerely,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
